name: Refugee Status

requirements.blocker_text: Loi No. 042-2008/AN (23 October 2008) governs refugee status. SP-CONAREF (Secretariat Permanent de la Commission Nationale pour les Refugies) receives and decides claims, with offices in Ouagadougou and regional branches (Dori, Djibo, Ouahigouya, Bobo-Dioulasso). Process: in-person registration and application form; an in-depth protection-officer interview; a second interview before the multi-ministry Eligibility Committee, which sits roughly every 3 months; a decision communicated about 60 days after the second interview; and, on denial, a 60-day window to appeal to a differently-constituted committee. The entire procedure is free of charge.
requirements.fix_path: Register in person at an SP-CONAREF office and complete the interview and Eligibility Committee review process.

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Burkina Faso). STATUS: DRAFT -- both sources are UNHCR's own country help pages, tier 2 (not a Burkinabe government domain directly); the primary statutory text of Loi No. 042-2008/AN was not independently fetched in this build. GENUINE, WELL-DOCUMENTED FINDING: Article 10's equal-treatment principle and near-full work-rights parity with nationals (barring civil service) is a real, specific, comparatively generous provision -- refugees may work on equal terms with Burkinabe nationals, a stronger position than several other countries' asylum files built in this dataset where work rights are vaguely 'restricted' pending separate authorization. work_rights is nonetheless set 'restricted' here only because civil-service posts are explicitly excluded -- not a blanket limitation. Burkina Faso is simultaneously a significant host country (per SP-CONAREF's own public statements, hosting a large refugee and asylum-seeker population from the wider Sahel crisis) and, since 2015-2016, a major source of internal displacement from its own escalating conflict -- this dual context is disclosed qualitatively rather than with an unverified specific figure, since no number found in this build's searches was independently confirmed via a fetched primary source. leads_to_pr and leads_to_citizenship set false: no source reviewed described a defined conversion path from refugee status to permanent residence or citizenship.
